final_message:
**Status: null result — no mechanism claimed, nothing verified.** The loaded checkpoint does not perform the behaviour, so I stopped at the baseline as the protocol requires.

**What the experiments showed** (all on `local-full`, full precision):

| Experiment | Sample | Agreement with recorded answers | Pre-registered prediction | Verdict |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| E0003 | n=200, seed 1 | 21.0% | at least 98% | refuted |
| E0004 | n=500, seed 2 | 21.8% | at most 30% | confirmed |

- **Chance level:** with 5 symbols chance is 20%, so both samples sit at chance.
- **No signal in the logits:** the correct-vs-incorrect logit difference averages about zero (2.06 and -4.23, with a spread of about 53) and is the same on clean and corrupt inputs.
- **Conflict with the task statement:** the brief says the dataset answers are the model's own outputs, but this checkpoint disagrees with them about 79% of the time. Either the loaded weights are not the ones that produced the labels or they have been altered; I can't tell which from inside the lab.

**Algorithm:** none recovered. I am naming no heads or MLP layers and offering no `predict()`, because any circuit here would be a false discovery.

**Verification numbers:** none. `verify_hypothesis` was not run because there is no hypothesis to verify.

**Prediction hit rate:** 1 of 2 (the refuted one was my opening assumption that the model does the task).

**Budget:** 4 of 25 experiments used (dataset inspection, one exploratory attribution screen, two baselines). The attribution screen (E0002) was uninterpretable and supports no claim.

One side observation, which is about the labels and not this model: in the 64 examples of E0001 the recorded answers fit a simple lookup rule. The last token selects one of positions 1–3, and the answer is a table lookup on the last token and the selected token. I fitted it by eye and did not test it on held-out data; it is recorded in the report as an open question only.

**Report:** `benchmarks\glassbox-bench\seed-1\runs\t4__null-weight-shuffled\report\report.md` (with `report.html` alongside).
